name: Click Before Frames
description: iOS diagnostic probe: measured tick debugger plus adjustable target-TPS setting. Prediction and input interception remain disabled. Windows reference: Windows-Achieved.md.

tick-rate-debugger.name: Tick-rate debugger
tick-rate-debugger.description: Show the measured player-1 update rate, update delta time, tick count, and selected target TPS. Read-only; does not change native game physics.

tick-rate-adjuster.name: Tick-rate adjuster (probe)
tick-rate-adjuster.description: Draggable target-TPS setting for testing the rate control and live settings updates. The debugger shows the selected target beside measured TPS. This probe does not change the game's native physics rate; the future prediction engine will consume a validated rate.
